pageCache.pageTitle: Side by Side School | Nurturing & Empowering Children with Special Needs
pageCache.text:
Believe, Achieve, Building Brighter Futures
Established in 1998, Side by Side provides an educational and therapeutic environment where children with special needs learn and thrive through tailored support, specialised interventions, and comprehensive services.
Yes They Can!
A unique integrated nursery for both mainstream children and those with special needs aged 2 to 5 years, encouraging all children to learn and play side by side with a high staff-to-child ratio, ensuring all their needs are met.
Side by Side Special School is a community school registered under the Department of Education, offering a unique learning environment for children aged 5 to 19.
Our therapy team includes Speech & Language, Occupational, Music, and Physiotherapists, supporting children on a 1:1 basis, in small groups, and through classroom-based interventions.
We aim for all children to achieve external qualifications through ASDAN Programmes and Functional Skills, and offer work experience placements with strong job coaching to support their development.‍
Our After School Club is designed for secondary-aged young people, providing varied activities, sports, and key life skills to expand experiences and opportunities for all children.
We offer comprehensive support to ensure families are involved in their child's education and development, providing resources to help parents understand their child's progress and needs.
We’re Always at Their Side
Raising a child with special needs presents unique challenges and significant demands. At Side by Side, parents will find an environment where their child can receive the care and support necessary to thrive, both academically and developmentally, in school and beyond.
We provide the highest level of education and specialised therapies, ensuring each child receives what they need to reach their full potential.
We offer personalised support for both children and parents, meeting each child’s unique needs and keeping families informed throughout the journey.
We empower all children, regardless of their ability, to thrive through a wide range of opportunities and programmes designed to foster growth and development.
Help Them Thrive
Your support will enable us to continue to provide our vital services and bring exciting new initiatives to life. Partner with us to make a difference for children with special needs, helping them thrive in school and become valued members of the community.
Stand By our Side
With your support, we can continue to support the special children in our community. Donate today to make a lasting impact every day.

British and Proud
We take great pride in our commitment to ensuring students engage with and truly understand the significance of celebrating British Values. Our curriculum is designed to reflect the diverse elements of the SMSC framework, allowing students to explore key themes that shape their growth as informed, respectful, and active citizens.
Upholding the principle that everyone is subject to the law, which protects individual freedoms.
Promoting the freedom of individuals to make their own choices and express their rights.
Encouraging respect for different beliefs, cultures, and backgrounds, fostering an environment of tolerance and understanding.
Emphasising the importance of participation in decision-making processes and the right to vote.

pageCache.pageTitle: About Us | Side by Side School for Special Needs Children
pageCache.text:
Unlocking Potential, One Child at a Time
At Side By Side we see past diagnoses and disabilities. We offer a range of services and programs ensuring each child reaches their full potential and succeeds in school and beyond.
It’s Their Story
1999: A Mother’s Vision Struggling to find a school for her 2-year-old son with Down Syndrome, Mrs. Rumpler founded Side by Side in her home. She envisioned a place where children with special needs could learn alongside their mainstream peers, and thus, Side by Side was born. ‍2001: Growth at Beis Chinuch ‍As Side by Side grew beyond Mrs. Rumpler's dining room, the school found its next home in a small room at Beis Chinuch School, expanding to 10 students in a small, nurturing environment. ‍2003: Expansion on Egerton Road ‍Side by Side relocated to portacabins on Egerton Road, growing to 23 children, with the introduction of its first school class and the hiring of its first qualified teacher. ‍2005: Recognition at Big Hill ‍The school moved to Big Hill, growing to 80 students and 120 staff, earning multiple 'Good' Ofsted reports and offering ASDAN accreditation. ‍October 2022: A New Era at the Ronson, Wohl, Esfandi Campus Side by Side moved to an incredible, purpose-built campus at Avigdor Mews. With 129 students and 167 staff members, this state-of-the-art building is creating exceptional opportunities, empowering every child to thrive and reach their full potential.
The Future of Changing Futures
Our goal is to continuously promote inclusivity, raise awareness, and create a supportive environment for children, their families, and our staff.
We are dedicated to helping each child reach their full potential by continually expanding our services to meet their evolving needs.
We aim to equip each child with the skills and confidence they need to thrive beyond school and achieve independence in the community.
A World of Learning, Fun, and Growth Watch a Day in Our World
In October 2022, we moved to our upgraded, state-of-the-art premises, which offer optimal opportunities for our children to grow and develop in spacious surroundings.
Our older students are working towards ASDAN accreditation, participating in various modules that enhance essential life skills and promote personal growth. They are also attending IT classes at VISTA, where they are acquiring vital skills to prepare them for life after school.
Since relocating, the school has experienced remarkable growth, with over a 60% increase in pupil intake. We are now once again able to welcome mainstream children alongside those with special educational needs, further enhancing our integrated nursery services.
We believe every child should be given equal opportunities, regardless of their abilities.
We understand the importance of a strong support system and offer invaluable guidance for families with children who have special needs.
We see past labels and believe that with the right help and support, every child can achieve a bright future and become a valued member of society.
We hire only the best teachers and specialist staff to ensure that children receive the highest quality education.
Stand by Our Side
With your support, we can continue to support the special children in our community. Donate today to make a lasting impact every day.

From Biking to Building and Beyond
As the day winds down and classes are over, we offer an after-school club for secondary-aged students, providing them with additional opportunities to learn and grow. From IT classes to sports sessions, children enjoy a relaxed and fun environment, honing their skills to advance and succeed. This invaluable programme, made possible through the support of trusts and foundations, offers activities that go beyond the scope of statutory funding, ensuring students have access to enriching experiences after school.
Top 5 Activities
After-School Club Highlights
More Opportunities
Our after-school club gives secondary-aged students extra chances to explore new interests and try new activities, helping them grow and learn beyond their typical classroom setting.
Physical Education
Our PE programmes emphasise the importance of health and wellbeing, encouraging students to stay active while building strength, coordination, and confidence. Through engaging physical activities, students develop healthy habits, enhance their fitness, and learn the value of teamwork and perseverance—all while having fun.
Advancing Skills
Students improve their skills through extra learning and hands-on activities, building their confidence and preparing them for future success.
Stand by Our Side
With your support, we can continue to support the special children in our community. Donate today to make a lasting impact every day.

Educating 52 Students with Special Needs
Head over to our campus and discover a vibrant and unique learning atmosphere where children with special needs are cherished and supported. Our team of skilled teachers and therapists is dedicated to providing each child with the education and tools they need to succeed and thrive.
What Sets Us Apart
One-to-One Support
At our special school, each student receives 1:1 or small group support within the classroom, ensuring their unique learning needs and challenges are addressed with personalised strategies.
Personalised Plans
We create individualised learning plans for each student, tailored to their specific strengths, needs, and goals. By focusing on each child's unique learning style, we provide the support they need to thrive.
Interactive Learning
Through fun and meaningful activities, we keep students motivated and excited about their education. Our specialised programs incorporate tools such as adaptive technology, communication devices for non-verbal students, sensory supports and specialised furniture. These resources make learning both engaging and enjoyable for every student.
British and Proud
We take great pride in our commitment to ensuring students engage with and truly understand the significance of celebrating British Values. Our curriculum is designed to reflect the diverse elements of the SMSC framework, allowing students to explore key themes that shape their growth as informed, respectful, and active citizens.
Meet Dovid...
He passes you your books at the local library. He’s 17 years old and has ASD. His dedicated mentor at Side By Side found him this placement and accompanies him on each visit, providing support and guidance. His mentor helped him settle in and showed him the ropes on his first day.‍Since starting, Dovid has grown in confidence, developed social skills, and now looks forward to each shift. The structured environment and responsibility have given him a sense of independence, pride, and purpose.
Setting them up for success.
Our workability/life skills programs support our 14-19-year-old pupils as they prepare for adulthood and life beyond school, focusing on independence and becoming valuable members of society. This includes practical work experience with local placements, where they receive a dedicated mentor to accompany them. For students who require a higher level of support, we provide in-house work experience placements, also with a dedicated mentor, to help develop employability skills and boost confidence.

Like a family for every family.
We offer full support to ensure families are guided and involved in their child's education and development. Through ongoing communication and helpful resources, families feel confident and supported as they navigate their child's journey to adulthood.
Meet, connect, support.
We provide continuous support to parents through open communication, regular updates, and community-building events, ensuring they feel fully involved and confident in their child's development.
Throughout the year, in addition to Annual Review meetings, we hold termly Touch Base meetings where parents can discuss their child's progress and development with teachers.
Our coffee afternoons provide a relaxed setting for parents to meet, share experiences, and address any concerns they may have.
Parents get an inside look with our weekly newsletter, keeping them informed about upcoming events, classroom activities, and important announcements.
We offer valuable resources, along with special evening sessions and training, to ensure parents have access to key information and the support they need to help their child succeed.
Stand by our side
With your support, we can continue to support the special children in our community. Donate today to make a lasting impact every day.

Learning Side by Side
Visit our integrated nursery and experience a dynamic, inclusive learning environment. Here, mainstream and special needs children aged 2-5 learn side by side, supported by a dedicated team of teachers and specialists.
Not Your Ordinary Nursery
Let’s Be Friends
Children learn to interact with a diverse group of peers, fostering empathy, cooperation, and communication skills. They gain exposure to different perspectives and abilities, promoting inclusive behaviour and social understanding.
Breaking Barriers
By learning together, children naturally develop an understanding and acceptance of differences. This inclusivity helps break down stereotypes and reduce the stigma associated with disabilities.
I Can Too!
Children without special needs serve as role models for their peers with special needs, demonstrating positive behaviours, social skills and play skills. This encourages children with special needs to engage and participate more actively.

With your support, we can continue to support the special children in our community. Donate today to make a lasting impact every day.

pageCache.pageTitle: Our Funders | Partners Supporting Side by Side School
pageCache.text:
Standing at Our Side
Thanks to our many generous funders and supporting charities, we are able to operate and expand our programs. Our recent move to the new, state-of-the-art Ronson Wohl Esfandi campus has been a game-changer, enabling us to offer more opportunities. We are constantly in need of more support and have many exciting initiatives we'd love to bring to life. With your help, we can continue helping the special children in our community succeed in school and beyond.
In October 2022, we moved to a purpose-built, state-of-the-art building at the Ronson, Wohl, Esfandi Campus at Avigdor Mews. Thanks to the steadfast support of our dedicated sponsors and donors, we are proud to operate in this exceptional facility. Our student body has expanded and our staff team has grown,reflecting the ever-increasing demand for our services. This new campus provides our students with beautiful surroundings, allowing them to flourish and develop, significantly contributing to their growth and success, and supporting their journey toward a brighter and better future.

Creating Brighter Futures.
At Side by Side, we offer more than just a school. Through a wide range of programs and activities, we provide children with special needs the opportunity to reach their full potential and become successful members of the community.
It’s only with your support
Thanks to the generous donors and charities listed below, we are able to fund and expand essential programs. Whether it's investing in sensory tools, specialised learning aids, or therapeutic interventions, we are constantly evolving to provide the best for our students. Your support enables us to maintain our services and bring new initiatives to life, giving children with special needs the resources and opportunities they need to thrive and succeed.
New Project Initiatives
We aim to provide more opportunities for children by expanding our offerings to include lunchtime activities such as art and music sessions.
We aspire to foster opportunities within the school to develop young adults' work skills in a structured environment, as well as to maintain continuous community involvement.
We wish to secure funding for direct therapy for individual children before the EHCP funding is approved, ensuring they receive early support for better developmental outcomes.
We seek to increase literacy skills for all students by establishing a Jewish Book Library, which will run alongside our secular library, offering a wider collection of literature.
We envision providing more sensory experiences to help students engage with their environment while learning to care for and enjoy watching the results of their efforts.
We strive to offer a high level of 'job coaching' to support placements, ensuring a higher staff-to-pupil ratio than in their regular school environment, as well as covering transport costs to placements as needed.
We Can’t Do It Without You

pageCache.pageTitle: Parent Information | Resources for Parents at Side by Side School
pageCache.text:
Information Corner
At Side by Side, we highly value parents' input in their child’s education and encourage active participation in all aspects of our programmes. We believe in building strong partnerships with families, ensuring parents are respected, kept fully informed, and meaningfully involved in their child’s journey with us.
Admissions at Side by Side SchoolSide by Side School provides a unique educational and therapeutic environment for children aged 2–19, focusing on supporting those with special educational needs. We offer placements for both children with special needs and mainstream children in an integrated setting.Application Process‍To apply, please request an application form from our School Office. All applications are reviewed confidentially by the Headteacher, who may request additional information or a home visit to ensure the best placement.Mainstream and Special Needs Placements‍For mainstream nursery placements, priority is given to:‍Looked-after childrenChildren of current staffSiblings of current and previous pupilsApplications by date receivedSpecial needs nursery placements prioritise children with an Education, Health and Care Plan (EHCP), along with consideration for looked-after children and those with additional needs.‍For children aged 5–19, most applications require an EHCP. The Headteacher and SENCO will meet with parents to assess the suitability of a place. We collaborate with local authorities to ensure we can meet each child’s needs, subject to funding approval and capacity.Waiting Lists and Appeals‍In cases of oversubscription, waiting lists are established. Appeals regarding admission decisions should be directed to the Board of Trustees. For full details, please refer to our Admissions Policy or contact the School Office.
If you require an Application Form for the school please contact us on 0208 880 8300 or by email to school@sidebyside.org.uk‍
See School Calendar below for term dates and school holidays.‍
At Side by Side, we are committed to ensuring a safe, healthy, and supportive environment for all our pupils. Our comprehensive health and safety policies are designed to meet the specific needs of each child and to maintain the highest standards of care across the school.‍We work closely with local NHS healthcare professionals, who provide expert guidance and training to our staff as needed. This collaboration ensures that we can respond effectively to the diverse medical and health needs of our pupils. Parents and carers play a vital role in this process, and we kindly ask that any changes to a child's medical or health needs are promptly communicated to the school manager so that our records remain accurate and up to date.Fire safety is a top priority at Side by Side. We maintain a thorough and up-to-date Fire Risk Assessment for the school, ensuring that our facilities are compliant and secure. To prepare pupils and staff for emergencies, we conduct up to two fire drills each term. These drills help everyone become familiar with our fire procedures and ensure a calm, organised response in the event of an emergency.Through careful planning, collaboration, and regular review, we are dedicated to safeguarding the health, safety, and well-being of every pupil, staff member, and visitor at Side by Side School.
In recent years, we have celebrated numerous student achievements through the ASDAN accreditation programme. Students have completed a range of courses, including Employability and the Award for Personal Development, earning Bronze, Silver, and Gold level awards. In the Employability programme, one group of students successfully achieved Entry Level 2 accreditation. At Side by Side, we continue to offer a variety of tailored programmes to meet the individual needs of our pupils. The table below highlights the programmes we have delivered in recent years. In addition to the ASDAN courses, students engage with Pearson’s Functional Maths and Literacy programme, which focuses on practical and life skills. They also participate in weekly work experience placements, many of which are closely linked to their ASDAN studies.
